description: Restartable review-only TexasSolver queue for the current high-value MTT flop evidence batch.
guardrails: Existing raw outputs are checkpoints and must be skipped unless Force is explicitly requested outside autostart.
Only one queue worker or console_solver process may run at a time.
Solver output remains review-only until poker review, provenance and scoped validation pass.
Do not append another expansion batch before this queue is complete and its evidence yield is reviewed.
